heading.title: Bankruptcy Order for Individuals and Partnership Firm

article.title: Validity of bankruptcy order.
article.content:
127Validity of bankruptcy order.

Section 127  ·  Part III · Chapter IV  ·  page 107 of the Act
The bankruptcy order passed by the Adjudicating Authority under section 126 shall continue to have effect till the debtor is discharged under section 138.
